kb_hero_en.instruct: Young American man, about 24, soft slightly husky light baritone, intimate close-mic first-person narration, dry deadpan humor, a little bewildered, natural conversational pace, clear diction.
kb_hero_en.ref: So I don't usually get packages. And then there's this box. With my name on it.

lines.text: I got a package. From me?
lines.emo: Puzzled. The last two words 'From me?' are a surprised question with clearly rising intonation.
Amazed, quiet. The last two words 'And me?' are a stunned question with clearly rising intonation.
Pleased and confident, quiet smug smile, not shouting, clear words.
Excited and scheming, fast, almost no pauses, ends with a delighted soft 'Wow'.

lines.text: Then why is he looking up?
lines.emo: Slow, nervous, quiet, every word clear.

lines.text: Someone up there is watching me. Just like I watched him.
lines.emo: Slow, scared whisper, with a long clear pause between the two sentences.
